items.definition:
protective covering
Knights wore heavy armor in battle.

an unmarried man; a university degree
He earned his bachelor's degree in engineering.

the use of force or threats to abuse or intimidate
Schools are working to prevent bullying.

an official document attesting to a status or level of achievement
She received her teaching certification last year.

a group of close-knit and interrelated families
The Scottish clans have a rich history.

a violent confrontation or argument
There was a clash between the two rival gangs.

a border separating two countries; the extreme limit of settled land
Space is often called the final frontier.

a firm hold or understanding
He has a good grasp of the subject.

a thing that motivates or encourages one to do something
The company offered a bonus as an incentive.

the state of being mentally ill; extreme folly
The crowd descended into madness after the goal.

combination of two companies
The two companies announced a merger.

position on a list
Her ranking improved after the last competition.

a person who manages or directs
The school superintendent announced new policies.

a feeling that something is wrong
He looked at her with suspicion.

an abnormal growth of tissue
The doctor found a small tumor.

movement of blood around the body; distribution of something
Regular exercise improves blood circulation.

official permission; space or distance
The plane received clearance for takeoff.

a remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection
It was a strange coincidence that we both wore the same outfit.

an inner feeling or voice viewed as acting as a guide to the rightness or wrongness of one's behavior
His conscience bothered him after he lied.

the quality of being committed to a task or purpose
Her dedication to her studies paid off with excellent grades.

the action of detaining someone or the state of being detained in official custody
He was given detention for misbehaving in class.

a small or tiny part, amount, or proportion of something

a person who is proposed or formally entered as a candidate for an office or as the recipient of a grant or award
She was a strong nominee for the Best Actress award.

an illegal act; a crime (UK spelling)
Driving without a licence is a serious offence.

a forecast
Her prediction about the weather was accurate.

a sharp point; a sudden increase
There was a sudden spike in temperatures.

an inclination
She has a tendency to procrastinate.

a distinguishing quality
Honesty is a valuable trait.

a great victory or achievement
Winning the championship was a great triumph.

mental sharpness and inventiveness
He is known for his quick wit.

an extra item of dress or equipment
She bought a new accessory for her phone.

an instance of one moving object striking violently against another
There was a collision between two cars.

sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others
She showed great compassion for the victims.

a place for the storage of large quantities of goods
The bus leaves from the main depot.

extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain
The animal was in great distress.

material that provides official information or evidence
Please bring all the necessary documentation.

a person's native land
He returned to his homeland after many years.

the granting of a license
The company handles software licensing.

the practice of focusing one's mind
She finds peace through daily meditation.

a component of blood; a state of matter
The doctor ordered a plasma test.

an urgent request; a defendant's answer to a charge
He made a plea for help.

official permission or approval; a penalty for disobedience
The UN imposed sanctions on the country.

the quality of being sensitive

a detailed description of requirements
Please check the product specifications.

person who buys and sells goods or stocks
The stock trader made a significant profit today.

an uncultivated, uninhabited, and inhospitable region

the study of the structure of the body
We studied human anatomy in biology class.

a person sent or authorized to represent others

a machine that produces electricity
We need a generator during power outages.

a small wood, orchard, or group of trees
We walked through the olive grove.

an object of worship; a person or thing greatly admired
Many young people look up to pop idols.

a deceptive appearance or impression

a reason for doing something
The police are trying to determine the killer's motive.

Networking is crucial for career development.

a legal official who conducts criminal prosecutions
The prosecutor presented strong evidence.

an act of open, organized, and armed resistance to an established government or ruler

a person who receives something

a dishonest scheme; a fraud
Be careful not to fall for that online scam.

an owner of shares in a company
The shareholders voted on the new proposal.

the imitation of the operation of a real-world process or system over time
The flight simulation was very realistic.

the act of overseeing or managing
Children require constant supervision.

a stretch of land, especially with regard to its physical features
The mountainous terrain was difficult to cross.

the people engaged in or available for work, either in a country or area or in a particular company or industry
The company is expanding its workforce.

a person injured or killed in an accident or war
There were many casualties reported after the earthquake.
